comparison.objective: Draw a self-retracting lifeline below lock speed and hook it to a harness D-ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Velocity-controlled webbing extraction and hook engagement, rather than hammer impact and recessed mandrel alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Below-lock-speed extension and D-ring attachment are implied; speed, engagement, load, and retraction thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Tests rate-sensitive reel handling and hooking, not fracture at a notch or containment of released pieces.
